summary: The change passes. It adds docs/system-facts.md, a short file (11 facts, each with a source) listing how Athena runs where the code can't show it. Both the planner and critic briefs now include it in full, in a "System facts" section. A new test fails when the budgets or sizes written in the file differ from the ones the code computes. A second test shows that a changed size, a changed budget, a missing line or an unknown set are each rejected. I ran `cargo test -p athena-context` (53 passed, including the three new file and brief tests) and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` (4 passed, including the unchanged planner and critic budget tests). Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and full test runs also passed. All five changed files are on the deliverables list, and no budgets were changed. Two small findings, neither blocking: the new test copies the code that builds each prompt set rather than sharing it with the existing budget test, so the two could drift apart; and two facts (the plain copy, and SSH remotes refused at admission) rest only on your request, which the file says openly.
